items.title: Typed elements cost every WEB element a recorded head: genapp:46 x1.0054, the element-heavy examples x1.0006 to x1.0015
items.discussion: CI perf leg red at next c1d58aaa (example:browser x1.0051, genapp:46 x1.0080 of the ceiling); five 1% ci bump rows added (browser, genapp:46, reactive-ui, router, rpc), to list at the Order 58 seal
items.area: crates/vilan-core/src/analyzer.rs (the typed-element rewrite in the std-item drain), elements.rs
items.body: The lane records each element head and its links during the walk and resolves each tag as a name. A program with no `[element]` function in scope pays this for nothing. Skip the recording when no `[element]` function is declared or imported anywhere the file can see (a per-world flag), or resolve the tag once per distinct name. Measure against genapp:46 with callgrind; retire the bump rows if the cost goes.
